instruction: Load both workspace1.code-workspace and workspace2.code-workspace as a multi-root workspace in a single VSCode window.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because workspace files (.code-workspace) cannot be loaded as separate entities within another workspace. While VSCode supports multi-root workspaces, you cannot nest or combine existing workspace files - you would need to create a new workspace file that references the folders directly.
